name: 3dui
title: Live 3D product sites
summary: Build live 3D product websites with three.js and Next.js: the object is code, lit like a photo studio and directed by the scroll.
useWhen: Build a 3D product page or hero where the product is rendered live
Model a product in code instead of importing a mesh file
Make metal and glass look real in three.js
Drive the camera through the product as the user scrolls
Add an exploded view with labeled callouts, or a blueprint mode
The 3D scene stutters or overheats phones
Add synthesized sound or a hold-to-act interaction to the scene

notFor.topic: CSS, View Transitions and scroll-driven animation without WebGL
Next.js routing, data and rendering around the scene
Core Web Vitals and loading performance of the page as a whole
Layout, typography and visual design of the surrounding page

references.title: Live 3D product sites
references.purpose: Read when building or changing a scroll-directed, studio-lit three.js product scene inside a Next.js site.

leaves.topic: Drive all motion from one shared clock
Adapt render quality to phones to hold frame rate
Lathe-turn round parts from a profile curve
Author physical metal and glass materials with brushed anisotropic finishes
Light the product with a PMREM studio environment rotated by the cursor
Direct a scroll-driven camera cue list that frames objects by size
Stagger exploded views with two-column callouts and a blueprint edges-only mode
Apply film-style post: MSAA HDR, bloom, ACES tone mapping and grain
Build procedural geometry in millimeters: SDF shapes, marching-squares trace, beveled extrude
Synthesize sound with Web Audio; unlock audio and tilt with one hold-to-act gesture
